blocking_findings.summary: --no-renames decomposes the archive git mv into deletions at openspec/changes/<id>/ plus additions at openspec/changes/archive/<date>-<id>/. Excluding `archive` suppressed only the additions, so an archive PR still derived the id of the change it was archiving. Measured: 247bc201 -> 1 id (blocking run against a dir with 0 files at that commit), 600744a5 -> 2 ids (ambiguity, hard red), a17e33f7 -> 1 id. Fixed by adding --diff-filter=d; all three then derive {} -> SKIP, normal PRs keep their own id, and a base predating an archive no longer trips ambiguity.

blocking_findings.summary: Its WHEN said the only touched paths are beneath archive/, which is false under the mandated --no-renames since a real archive commit touches paths at the source too. Rewritten to describe the git mv, and to assert neither half yields an id.
